description: This file defines the DetailedLeave class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to encapsulate detailed information about a leave request in the OrangeHRM system. It manages leave data, related statuses, period calculations, available actions, and associated workflows.

classes.name: DetailedLeave
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that encapsulates detailed information about a specific leave request, including status, period, balance, allowed actions, and workflows.

methods.name: getLeave
methods.description: Returns the Leave object associated with this detailed leave.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Sets the Leave object and resets cached details.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets multiple leave entries and resets cached details.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the iterable collection of leaves associated.

methods.name: getDatesDetail
methods.description: Returns detailed date information of the leave, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getLeaveStatus
methods.description: Returns the current leave status along with length days information.

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the leave balance for the employee and leave type within the leave period.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Calculates and returns the leave period based on leaves and leave entitlement strategy.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Returns the list of permitted actions for the current leave status.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves the allowed workflow states for a given leave status.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action (e.g., approve, reject) is permitted for this leave.

methods.name: getWorkflowForAction
methods.description: Returns the workflow state associated with a specific action.
